reply.analysis: Proven: beta = 220 for 715 receivers (bracket [220, 220]). The lower bound is an independent set of size 220; the upper bound is a linear code M = I + 4A over F_5 of length 220. All four checks passed (independent_set, code_fits, factorization, decoding). The agent needed 4 LLM calls and 2 critic rounds; wall time was 38.99 s, of which 38.83 s was LLM time and only 0.156 s was compute. Baselines: CP-SAT alpha also gave 220 (proven, 12.2 s). CP-SAT cover (604) and fractional cover (635) were unproven at the 120 s limit. F2 minrank SAT reached only 219, a lower bound. The earlier rule-based agent also got 220 in 0.28 s, so it was faster than this agent. Nothing suspicious.
